summary: Pre-commit QA pass for BATCH N1-B2 (consent gaps) + BATCH N2 (versioning). All 73 backend pytest tests pass (test_notetaker_phase1.py + test_notetaker_tasks.py). Verified every specific acceptance item from the founder spec via live browser testing on voicetest2026@example.com and direct backend API calls with a fresh throwaway unverified advocate. No bugs found; all checked items PASS.

action_items: No blocking issues found. Ready for founder review/commit as far as this QA pass's checked items go.

Minor non-blocking observation: the 'Continue with manual notes only' confirmation (pre-existing N1 feature, not in this batch's scope) and the consultation 'Cancel' confirmation on [id].tsx still use crossAlert (likely window.confirm on web) rather than the new ConfirmModal -- flagging only for awareness since the founder's instruction was about NEW dialogs; these are pre-existing and were explicitly out of scope for this pass.
critical_code_review_comments: advocate_notetaker_router.py is 1637 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into matters/consent/notes/export/tasks sub-routers in a future refactor (not blocking).

Backend _require_verified_advocate's HTTPException detail string contains the word 'verified' ("This action requires a verified advocate profile...") -- this is fine because the frontend never renders this raw backend message for the three gated UI states (it uses its own hardcoded strings), but if any other call site ever surfaces e.detail directly to a user, it would violate the founder's wording ban. Worth a grep sweep as a follow-up, not urgent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all manually tested N1-B2 and N2 UI flows passed)

seed_data_creation: Created throwaway TEST_-prefixed data for this pass: TEST_QA_ConsentUnknown, TEST_QA_LateConsent, TEST_QA_N2Versioning, TEST_QA_Regression_HappyPath consultations/matters + their TEST_Participant_* consent records, under the existing voicetest2026@example.com account; also one fresh throwaway unverified advocate user (test_unverified_*@example.com, not persisted/recorded) for the 403-gating API cross-check. None of this touches or mutates any pre-existing data from prior QA sessions (e.g. TEST_Matter_ConsentN1B2's existing 6 consultations were only read, never modified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both BATCH N1-B2 and BATCH N2 are fully verified against the founder's detailed acceptance spec: all backend pytest (73/73) and all frontend UI checks listed above passed with exact wording matches quoted in spec_item_results. The only item not independently re-verified via two real browser tabs was the live version-conflict UI (N2 item), per the spec's own explicit fallback -- backend test_two_tabs_same_base_version_second_gets_409 passing was used as the accepted evidence. Everything is ready for the founder's final go-ahead; no code changes were made during this QA pass.
